description: The architectural/user-journey gap ledger (the Successor Tech Lead Directive §13): every known gap between the current state and the level-6 maturity target, each with its evidence, owner and status. Gaps are ADDED and TRANSITIONED, never silently deleted — a gap closes only with recorded evidence at the level its claim requires.

levels.0: absent — no contract, no code, no evidence
levels.1: architecture contract — the neutral port/seam exists and is pinned, no implementation
levels.2: fake-local proof — a simulated/in-process implementation passes the contract; honest labels, no real-external claims
levels.3: credentialed real-external proof — a real provider answers over the real transport with the operator's credentials; every boundary honestly NOT RUN otherwise
levels.4: repeatable public journey — the capability serves a real user journey end-to-end on a public plane at an exact attested revision
levels.5: provider-replaceable + failure-tested — a conformance contract plus at least one alternate solution, with failure drills and governed failover
levels.6: production-grade — sustained observation, monitoring, recovery and cost accounting under real load

maturityModel.rule: levels are never collapsed to PASS/FAIL; every level-3+ claim cites its evidence record
